name.en: Vibrant Acai Bowl with Fresh Fruit and Granola
name.uk: Яскрава чаша з асаї зі свіжими фруктами та гранолою

alt.en: Vibrant Acai Bowl with Fresh Fruit and Granola
alt.uk: Яскрава чаша з асаї зі свіжими фруктами та гранолою

description: A vibrant acai bowl is filled with a colorful array of fresh fruits and toppings. Sliced strawberries, blueberries, blackberries, and banana slices are artfully arranged on top of the smooth acai base. Granola is sprinkled generously, adding a crunchy texture to the dish. The fruits are fresh and glistening, with the strawberries and blueberries providing a pop of red and blue against the dark acai. The bowl is set against a dark background, which enhances the vivid colors of the fruits and makes them stand out. Scattered around the bowl are additional berries and granola, adding to the natural and wholesome feel of the scene.
